basis.quote: All calculations used the 6-31+G** basis set.

multiplicity.quote: State-averaged calculations were performed for the two lowest singlet states, _S_ 0 and _S_ 1.

software.quote: SACIS and SAECIS, together with their analytical nuclear gradients, were implemented in the Gellan suite of programs,<sup>52</sup> and all calculations were performed with this code except for SA-CASSCF and SF-TDDFT, which were carried out with OpenMolcas<sup>53</sup> and ORCA<sup>54</sup> , respectively.
